INSTAGRAM
The pre-mortem prompt: imagine your plan already failed, then fix the causes before they happen.

Asking "what could go wrong?" gets polite answers. Asking "why did it fail?" gets honest ones.
Paste the prompt into Claude, name your plan, then turn each cause into one cheap guardrail.
Use it for decisions worth an hour of thought: changing jobs, launching an app, pricing, hiring.

Save this one. Follow @manrajtalks for practical Claude tips you can use the same day.
